key_subdivisions_for_case: Unsworn declaration has 'like force and effect' as sworn statement when properly executed
Requirements: recites 'certified or declared under penalty of perjury' + subscribed (signed)
(a) If executed within California: must state date AND place of execution
(b) If executed anywhere (within or without CA): must state date + 'under the laws of the State of California'
Exceptions: does not apply to depositions, oaths of office, or oaths before specified officials other than notaries
cross_references: Code of Civil Procedure § 2009 (affidavits in support of motions)
Code of Civil Procedure § 2010 (verification of pleadings)
Evidence Code § 710 (oath or affirmation of witness)
Family Code § 212 (declaration under penalty of perjury in family law)
